controls.description: Frequency of the dissolve pattern (higher = smaller blobs)

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Intensity of the angular blur effect

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: Spectral color fringing along the streak, like light through a lens; negative flips which end is red

controls.name: falloff
controls.description: Concentrates the dispersion away from the center; 0 fringes everywhere equally

controls.name: focus
controls.description: Radius of a clean zone around the center that stays sharp

controls.name: bias
controls.description: Trails the sweep off one side of each pixel instead of both; the sign picks the direction

controls.name: highlights
controls.description: Lets bright pixels streak further than dark ones, like light rays

controls.name: jitter
controls.description: Per-pixel noise on the tap spacing that hides banding in long streaks

summary.zh: 圆盘切出可调开口，适合仪表和环形装饰。

controls.description: Brightness curve adjustment. <1 brightens darks (more light characters), >1 darkens midtones (more dark characters). Use to better fit characters to image brightness range.

controls.name: alphaThreshold

controls.name: preserveAlpha
controls.description: When enabled, output alpha matches input alpha. When disabled, pixels above the alpha threshold become fully opaque.

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Direction of the bend axis in degrees — 0 bends the left/right ends, 90 bends the top/bottom

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle edges when the bend pulls content away from the frame border

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Color of agents cruising calmly with the flock

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Color agents flash toward when agitated — scattering from the predator cursor or banking through a hard turn

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for the rest→excited color ramp

controls.name: agentShape
controls.description: What each agent is drawn as — a hard-edged arrow, streak or square pointing along its heading, a plain dot, or a soft glowing comet

controls.name: count
controls.description: Number of flocking agents

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Overall cruising speed of the flock

controls.name: seed

controls.name: size

controls.name: cursorMode
controls.description: How the flock reacts to the cursor

controls.name: cursorStrength

summary.zh: 粗细与角度可调的网格线，适合图纸风背景。
summary.ja: 太さと角度を変えられる格子線。図面風の背景に。
summary.en: Simple grid lines pattern with adjustable thickness and rotation

controls.name: color
controls.description: The color of the grid lines

controls.name: cellColor
controls.description: Fill color of the cells (transparent = lines only). Pair with Variation for a tiled look.

controls.name: cells
controls.description: Number of cells along the canvas height (cells stay square; the width fits as many as the aspect ratio allows)

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Thickness of grid lines (normalized, 0.0-1.0)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the grid in degrees. At 45° this produces a crosshatch/diamond pattern.

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Softness of the line edges (0 = crisp, 1 = very soft)

controls.name: variation
controls.description: Per-cell random lightening/darkening of the cell fill color

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

summary.zh: 鼠标推挤网格中的底图，适合互动封面。
summary.ja: マウスが格子状に画像を押し曲げる。触れるカバーに。
summary.en: Interactive grid distortion controlled by mouse position

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Strength of the distortion effect

controls.name: decay
controls.description: Rate of distortion decay (higher = faster)

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Radius of the distortion effect

controls.name: gridSize
controls.description: Resolution of the distortion grid (higher = more detailed)

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle edges when distortion pushes content out of bounds

summary.zh: 大小可调的心形，适合喜欢反馈和浪漫装饰。
summary.ja: 大きさを調整できるハート。いいねやロマンチックな装飾に。
summary.en: Heart shape with adjustable size

controls.name: color
controls.description: Fill color of the heart

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Size of the heart (fit radius)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation in degrees

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Edge softness for antialiasing

controls.name: strokeThickness
controls.description: Stroke thickness. Zero means no stroke.

controls.name: strokeColor
controls.description: Color of the stroke outline

controls.name: strokePosition
controls.description: Position of the stroke relative to the shape edge

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for blending fill and stroke colors

summary.zh: 形状内部流过热力色彩，适合科幻材质展示。
summary.ja: 形の中に熱を示す色が流れる。SF風の質感表現に。
summary.en: Thermal-camera heat flowing through any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape. Powered by Paper Shaders.

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the heatmap shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the heatmap shape in degrees

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Cold color (used when no gradient stops are set)

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Hot color (used when no gradient stops are set)

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for the heat ramp interpolation

controls.name: innerGlow
controls.description: Heat filling the inside of the shape

controls.name: outerGlow
controls.description: Heat radiating beyond the silhouette

controls.name: contour
controls.description: Heat concentrated along the shape boundary

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Direction the heat waves travel, in degrees

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed of the flowing heat. 0 pauses.

summary.zh: 六边形连续铺开，适合科技与蜂窝风背景。
summary.ja: 六角形を敷き詰める。テック系や蜂の巣風の背景に。
summary.en: Honeycomb hexagonal grid pattern

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Cell fill color

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Grid line color

controls.name: cells
controls.description: Number of hexagons along the canvas height (the width fits as many as the aspect ratio allows)

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Thickness of the hex grid lines

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the grid in degrees

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Softness of the line edges (0 = crisp, 1 = very soft)

controls.name: variation
controls.description: Per-cell random lightening/darkening of the cell fill color

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

summary.zh: 半透明形体带扫描线闪动，适合科幻图标。
summary.ja: 半透明の形に走査線が揺れる。SF風のアイコンに。
summary.en: Volumetric sci-fi hologram — a translucent emissive projection of the shape with fresnel-lit edges, depth scan-lines that wrap 3D forms, CRT scanlines, flicker and beam wobble

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the hologram shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the hologram shape in degrees

controls.name: color
controls.description: Projection tint — the color the whole hologram emits (classic sci-fi cyan by default)

controls.name: brightness
controls.description: Overall emission gain. Bright edges blow out toward white for a hot, projected look.

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge — keep low for crisp projection edges

controls.name: fill
controls.description: Translucent interior glow. Driven by optical thickness, so thicker parts of a 3D form glow more — the core volumetric cue.

controls.name: edgeGlow
controls.description: Fresnel rim intensity — bright glowing silhouette and, on 3D shapes, the grazing internal walls of extruded logos

controls.name: depthLines
controls.description: Iso-depth scan-lines that hug the surface and reveal the 3D form like a volumetric scan. On flat shapes they become concentric contour rings.

controls.name: depthScale
controls.description: Density of the depth scan-lines — higher packs more contour bands through the volume

controls.name: scanlines
controls.description: CRT scanline contrast — how dark the gaps between horizontal projection lines get

controls.name: scanlineScale
controls.description: Number of horizontal scanlines across the canvas height

controls.name: scanlineSpeed
controls.description: How fast the scanlines drift upward — 0 holds them static

controls.name: sweep
controls.description: Brightness of the refresh bar that sweeps vertically through the projection

controls.name: flicker
controls.description: Unstable-projector flicker — a fast shimmer plus occasional brightness dropouts

controls.name: distortion
controls.description: Continuous horizontal wobble and chromatic edge fringing — the wavering of an unstable beam

controls.name: grain
controls.description: Fine projection static — animated per-pixel noise over the emission

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Master animation speed for every animated layer. 0 freezes the projection.

summary.zh: 彩虹反光与亮片掠过表面，适合镭射徽章。
summary.ja: 虹色の反射ときらめきが走る。箔風のバッジに。
summary.en: Iridescent holographic foil sticker with animated rainbow sheen and glitter flakes

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the foil shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the foil shape in degrees

controls.name: hueShift
controls.description: Rotates the rainbow spectrum across the foil

controls.name: foilScale
controls.description: Size of the iridescent color patches — higher = smaller, busier patches

controls.name: saturation
controls.description: Rainbow saturation — 0 = plain silver foil, 1 = fully spectral

controls.name: roughness
controls.description: Matte laminate grain — softens the gloss with fine paper-like noise

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Animation speed — the spectrum drifts across the foil as if the sticker is tilting in your hand. 0 pauses.

controls.name: crinkle
controls.description: Laminate wrinkles — perturbs the surface so the sheen and rainbow swirl locally instead of lying flat

controls.name: crinkleScale
controls.description: Size of the laminate wrinkles — higher = smaller, denser wrinkles

controls.name: sparkle
controls.description: Glitter flakes embedded in the foil — tiny facets that refract a shifted hue and twinkle as the spectrum drifts

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

summary.zh: 底图颜色沿色轮轮换，适合配色探索和变色背景。
summary.ja: 画像の色を色相環に沿って動かす。配色の検討に。
summary.en: Rotate hue around the color wheel

controls.name: shift
controls.description: The amount to shift the hue by

summary.zh: 把图片铺进画布并调整适配，适合组合滤镜。
summary.ja: 画像をキャンバスに配置する。フィルターの組み合わせに。
summary.en: Display an image with customizable object-fit modes

controls.name: objectFit
controls.description: How the image should be sized within the viewport

summary.zh: 拖动指针画出翻卷墨带，适合可绘画的背景。
summary.ja: ドラッグで渦巻くインクを描く。描いて遊べる背景に。
summary.en: Drag to paint swirling ribbons of ink through a real fluid field — eddies keep evolving after you let go

controls.name: colorMode
controls.description: How the brush color is chosen: an ever-cycling rainbow, a single fixed color, or a custom three-color cycle

controls.name: colorSpeed
controls.description: How quickly the brush cycles through the rainbow or the custom colors as you paint

controls.name: color
controls.description: Brush color used when Color Mode is Single

controls.name: color1
controls.description: First color of the custom brush cycle

controls.name: color2
controls.description: Second color of the custom brush cycle

controls.name: color3
controls.description: Third color of the custom brush cycle

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: color space the custom colors blend through as the brush cycles between them

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Size of the ink splat painted under the cursor

controls.name: force
controls.description: How hard the cursor's motion pushes the fluid — higher throws faster, more violent jets and curls

controls.name: curl
controls.description: Vorticity confinement — swirl energy that spins the ink into persistent eddies and curls

controls.name: decay
controls.description: How fast the ink fades away — low values leave long, lingering trails

controls.name: momentum
controls.description: How long the fluid keeps flowing after a stroke — high momentum lets the motion carry on and on

summary.zh: 翻转底图的红绿蓝数值，适合负片和强烈对比。
summary.ja: 画像のRGBを反転する。ネガや強い対比の表現に。
summary.en: Invert RGB colors while preserving alpha

summary.zh: 圆形开口从中心扩张，适合聚焦式场景切换。
summary.ja: 中心から円を広げる。焦点を絞る場面転換に。
summary.en: Reveal through an expanding circle growing from a center point

controls.name: progress
controls.description: How far the iris has expanded (0 = fully visible, 1 = fully wiped away)

controls.name: feather
controls.description: Softness of the iris edge

controls.name: invert
controls.description: Wipe from the outside inward instead

summary.zh: 彩色灯光照亮轮廓并向外溢出，适合发光徽章。
summary.ja: 色の光が輪郭を照らして周囲へ広がる。光るバッジに。
summary.en: Photorealistic light spilling around the edge of any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape — any number of movable colored point lights strike the silhouette and the lit edges irradiate their surroundings, gathered in a compute pass with real cast shadows, mixing where they meet and burning to white at the rim

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the shape in degrees

controls.name: lightHeight
controls.description: Height of the lights above the shape plane, relative to the shape — low lights graze the body, high lights flood it evenly

controls.name: lightRange
controls.description: Reach of each light — the distance at which it has fallen to half strength, relative to the shape

controls.name: reach
controls.description: How far from the shape the spilled light is gathered, relative to the shape — the glow fades out toward this distance

controls.name: core
controls.description: The lit edge seen directly — the white-hot line along the rim where the lights strike

controls.name: wrap
controls.description: How far light wraps around edges that face away from it — 0 leaves the far side dark

controls.name: shadows
controls.description: Cast shadows — the body blocks each light from edges it stands in front of (keeps holes and concave pockets dark)

controls.name: shadowSoftness
controls.description: Penumbra width of the cast shadows — 0 is razor sharp

controls.name: bodyColor
controls.description: Color of the shape itself — black for a pure occluder, lighter to see the lights land on its form

controls.name: bodyLight
controls.description: How much the lights illuminate the body — the bevel of a flat shape or the form of a 3D one

controls.name: bevelWidth
controls.description: Width of the rounded edge a flat shape catches the light on, relative to the shape

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

summary.zh: 菱形拼成错视立方块，适合立体几何底纹。
summary.ja: ひし形を立方体に見えるように並べる。立体的な背景模様に。
summary.en: Isometric tumbling-blocks tiling — a 3D cube illusion (rhombille pattern)

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Base cube color

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Second cube color, mixed in per-cube for variation

controls.name: lineColor
controls.description: Color of the cube edge lines

controls.name: cells
controls.description: Number of cubes across the shortest canvas edge

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Thickness of the cube edge lines (0 = no edges)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the tiling in degrees

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Softness of the edge lines (0 = crisp, 1 = very soft)

controls.name: colorVariation
controls.description: Per-cube random blend between the two colors (0 = uniform cubes, the clean 3D look)

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

summary.zh: 底图沿径向反复镜像，适合对称花纹背景。
summary.ja: 画像を放射状に反射する。対称模様の背景に。
summary.en: Create a kaleidoscope effect with radial mirrored segments

controls.name: segments
controls.description: Number of radial segments in the kaleidoscope

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Rotation offset for the entire kaleidoscope pattern

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle edges when distortion pushes content out of bounds

summary.zh: 桶形弯曲与色差叠在底图上，适合镜头感配图。
summary.ja: 樽型のゆがみと色収差を加える。レンズ感のある挿絵に。
summary.en: Split content into shifting chromatic layers with barrel or pincushion lens warp. Powered by Paper Shaders.

controls.name: spread
controls.description: Strength of the color split; how far the color layers are pushed apart (0 is off)

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Direction of the spread in degrees

controls.name: perspective
controls.description: Shapes the spread direction from a straight line (0) to a radial burst out from the centre (1)

controls.name: bias
controls.description: Shifts the colors toward one end of the spread; 0 spaces them evenly

controls.name: count
controls.description: Number of sampled color layers along the spread; higher is smoother and costlier

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: Overall amount of color dispersion; 1 gives each layer its own color from the spectrum, 0 keeps the original color

controls.name: dispersionShift
controls.description: Balance of the dispersion between a soft circular zone at the centre and the rest; -1 keeps it in the centre only, 1 at the edges only

controls.name: dispersionColor
controls.description: Rotates the dispersion colors around the hue wheel, 0 to 1 for a full turn

controls.name: focusCenter
controls.description: Reduces the spread in a circular zone at the centre; 0 keeps it full to the centre

controls.name: focusEdges
controls.description: Reduces the spread toward the edges; 1 restores the original image there

controls.name: lensBulge
controls.description: Radial lens warp; positive bulges out like a fisheye, negative pinches in like a pincushion

controls.name: lensCircle
controls.description: Squeezes pixels outside the inscribed circle inward so the outline becomes a circle

controls.name: swirl
controls.description: Rotates the color layers around the centre by an angle growing along the spread; 0 is off

controls.name: noise
controls.description: Scatters the spread direction with noise; 0 is off

controls.name: noiseFrequency
controls.description: Frequency of the direction noise; higher is finer (no effect with noise at 0)

controls.name: noiseOffset
controls.description: Offsets the noise pattern for a different seed (no effect with noise at 0)

controls.name: grainMixer
controls.description: Scatters the spread with grain noise, breaking up the edges of the color layers

controls.name: grainOverlay
controls.description: Post-processing black/white grain overlay

summary.zh: 镜头反光带出光晕与鬼影，适合电影感封面。
summary.ja: レンズの光輪やゴーストを描く。映画風のカバーに。
summary.en: Realistic camera lens flare with artifacts.

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Master brightness of the entire lens flare effect

controls.name: ghostIntensity
controls.description: Brightness of internal reflection ghost discs along the flare axis

controls.name: ghostSpread
controls.description: Spacing between ghost reflections along the flare axis

controls.name: ghostChroma
controls.description: Rainbow chromatic fringing around ghost element edges

controls.name: haloIntensity
controls.description: Brightness of the circular halo ring from internal reflection

controls.name: haloRadius
controls.description: Radius of the halo ring

controls.name: haloChroma
controls.description: Spectral dispersion on the halo creating rainbow color separation

controls.name: haloSoftness
controls.description: Thickness and softness of the halo ring

controls.name: starburstIntensity
controls.description: Brightness of diffraction spikes radiating from the light source

controls.name: starburstPoints
controls.description: Number of starburst spikes (simulates aperture blade count)

controls.name: streakIntensity
controls.description: Brightness of horizontal anamorphic light streak

controls.name: streakLength
controls.description: Horizontal extent of the anamorphic streak

controls.name: glareIntensity
controls.description: Soft veiling glare that washes out contrast around the light

controls.name: glareSize
controls.description: Size of the soft glare glow

controls.name: edgeFade
controls.description: How much the flare fades when the light source is near the screen edge (0 = no fade, 1 = heavy fade)

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed of subtle flare shimmer and starburst rotation

summary.zh: 脉动光线绕着边缘奔跑，适合发光标志。
summary.ja: 脈打つ光が輪郭を巡る。光るロゴの表現に。
summary.en: Glowing, pulsing light racing around the edge of any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape. Powered by Paper Shaders.

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the shape in degrees

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: First border light color (used when no gradient stops are set)

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Second border light color (used when no gradient stops are set)

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space overlapping lights blend in

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Width of the border band

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Edge softness — 0 = crisp band, 1 = wide smooth gradient

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Brightness of the individual light spots

controls.name: bloom
controls.description: How additively overlapping lights pile up — high values overdrive to white

controls.name: spots
controls.description: Number of light spots orbiting per color

controls.name: spotSize
controls.description: Angular size of each light spot

controls.name: pulse
controls.description: Heartbeat pulsing — synchronizes the lights to a double-beat rhythm

controls.name: smoke
controls.description: Noisy luminous smoke drifting along the border

controls.name: smokeSize
controls.description: Scale of the smoke billows

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Animation speed. 0 pauses.

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed — re-rolls spot speeds, directions and phases

summary.zh: 暖色过曝光带缓缓呼吸，适合胶片风配图。
summary.ja: 暖かな露光の帯がゆっくり揺れる。フィルム風の挿絵に。
summary.en: Photorealistic film light leak — warm overexposed light bleeding in from a draggable anchor point, with streak bands, chromatic fringing, and slow breathing that evolves over time

controls.name: spread
controls.description: How far the light bleeds into the frame

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Exposure strength of the leak

controls.name: streaks
controls.description: Strength of the parallel streak bands further into the frame

controls.name: colorHot
controls.description: Core color where the leak is fully overexposed

controls.name: colorMid
controls.description: Main body color of the leak

controls.name: colorFringe
controls.description: Outer fringe color where the light fades out

controls.name: flicker
controls.description: Breathing of the leak intensity

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed of the breathing, drift and evolution. 0 freezes the leak.

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed — re-rolls the drift and breathing pattern

summary.zh: 两点之间画出实线或虚线，适合连线和装饰。
summary.ja: 二点を実線や破線で結ぶ。接続線や装飾に。
summary.en: Draw a straight line between two points with color, thickness, and solid, dashed, or dotted styles

controls.name: color
controls.description: The color of the line

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: The thickness of the line. A value of one (1) matches the canvas height.

controls.name: style
controls.description: The line style: solid, dashed, or dotted. Dashes and dots are spaced to land exactly on both endpoints.

controls.name: dashLength
controls.description: The length of each dash, including its caps

controls.name: gapLength
controls.description: The gap between dashes, or the spacing between dots

controls.name: capStart
controls.description: Cap shape at the start of the line (point A). Rounded caps center on the endpoint; square caps end flat exactly at it. Also shapes the A-facing end of each dash and dot.

controls.name: capEnd
controls.description: Cap shape at the end of the line (point B). Rounded caps center on the endpoint; square caps end flat exactly at it. Also shapes the B-facing end of each dash and dot.

summary.zh: 沿指定角度拉出残影，适合速度感和滑动转场。
summary.ja: 指定した方向に残像を伸ばす。速度感やスライド転換に。
summary.en: Directional motion blur in a specific angle

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Intensity of the linear blur effect

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Direction of the linear blur (in degrees)

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: Spectral color fringing along the streak, like light through a lens; negative flips which end is red

controls.name: falloff
controls.description: Concentrates the dispersion away from the center; 0 fringes everywhere equally

controls.name: focus
controls.description: Radius of a clean zone around the center that stays sharp

controls.name: bias
controls.description: Trails the streak off one side of each pixel like a comet; the sign picks the direction

controls.name: highlights
controls.description: Lets bright pixels streak further than dark ones, like light rays

controls.name: jitter
controls.description: Per-pixel noise on the tap spacing that hides banding in long streaks

summary.zh: 颜色沿直线平滑过渡，适合按钮和背景底色。
summary.ja: 直線に沿って色が変わる。ボタンや背景の下地に。
summary.en: Create smooth linear color gradients

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: The starting color of the gradient

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: The ending color of the gradient

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Additional rotation angle of the gradient (in degrees)

controls.name: edges
controls.description: How to handle areas beyond the gradient endpoints

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

summary.zh: 柔边直线扫过并擦去画面，适合简洁转场。
summary.ja: 柔らかな直線で画面を消す。シンプルな場面転換に。
summary.en: Wipe the content away along a straight edge with a soft feathered transition

controls.name: progress
controls.description: How far the wipe has travelled (0 = fully visible, 1 = fully wiped away)

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Direction of the wipe in degrees (0 = left to right)

controls.name: feather
controls.description: Softness of the wipe edge

controls.name: invert
controls.description: Reverse the direction the wipe travels

summary.zh: 熔融铬面折叠流动反光，适合金属风图标。
summary.ja: 溶けたクロームのひだに光が流れる。金属風アイコンに。
summary.en: Flowing liquid chrome — a molten reflective surface that wraps the shape, sweeping a procedural studio reflection across animated folds with crisp speculars and prismatic edges

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the metal shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the metal shape in degrees

controls.name: lightColor
controls.description: The bright tone of the chrome highlights

controls.name: darkColor
controls.description: The dark tone the reflection falls to in shadow — recolor for tinted metal (gold, steel, copper…)

controls.name: turbulence
controls.description: How molten the surface is — the depth of the flowing folds that bend the reflection

controls.name: ripple
controls.description: Scale of the molten folds — higher = smaller, busier ripples

controls.name: warp
controls.description: Swirl of the flow — domain-warps the folds into liquid curls

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed of the molten flow and the slowly drifting reflection. 0 pauses.

controls.name: environment
controls.description: Strength of the reflected studio lighting — the softboxes seen across the metal

controls.name: envRotation
controls.description: Rotates the reflected studio — spins where the bright reflections fall

controls.name: sharpness
controls.description: Tightness of the specular highlights — 1 = razor chrome glints, 0 = soft satin

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: Prismatic color fringing along the reflection edges

controls.name: lightAngle
controls.description: Direction of the key light for the specular glints, in degrees

controls.name: bevelWidth
controls.description: Width of the edge bevel, relative to the shape — thin for machined jewellery edges, wide for soft pillowed metal

controls.name: bevelShape
controls.description: Bevel profile — 0 = one smooth round fillet, 1 = machined: a steep outer fillet, a chamfer plateau and an inner knee, each catching its own line of light

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

summary.zh: 指针把底图推成流体，适合可触摸的海报。
summary.ja: カーソルで画像を液体のように動かす。触れるポスターに。
summary.en: Liquid-like interactive deformation effect

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Scale of the fabric displacement effect

controls.name: stiffness
controls.description: Fabric rigidity (higher = stiffer canvas, lower = stretchy silk)

controls.name: damping
controls.description: How quickly fabric motion settles

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Cursor influence area

controls.description: Color of filings resting quietly, aligned and still

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Color filings flash toward as they swing and settle — a wave of it follows the moving magnet

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for the rest→excited color ramp

controls.name: shape
controls.description: How each filing is drawn — a slim streak or arrow reads as a compass needle, a box as a chunky filing, a dot or soft glow for a finer grain

controls.name: count

controls.name: size

controls.name: restOrientation
controls.description: Which way filings point where the field can't reach them — randomly, all horizontal, or all vertical

controls.name: fieldType

controls.name: strength

controls.name: reach

controls.name: response

summary.zh: 玻璃形体封住发光星云与星点，适合宇宙风徽章。
summary.ja: ガラスの形に星雲と星を閉じ込める。宇宙風バッジに。
summary.en: A volumetric gas nebula sealed inside polished glass; billowing emission clouds with hollow dark cavities and hot glowing cores, star fields drifting at real depth behind the gas, all refracted through the curved walls of the shape and dressed with studio reflections

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the nebula shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the nebula shape in degrees

controls.name: coreColor
controls.description: The hot color the densest gas cores glow with — the embedded newborn stars

controls.name: gasColor
controls.description: The main emission color of the gas body — H-alpha rose by default

controls.name: veilColor
controls.description: The color of the thin outer veils and the deep-space background behind the gas

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space the veil → gas → core ramps blend in

controls.name: density
controls.description: Optical density of the gas — how strongly clouds occlude the stars and gas behind them

controls.name: cavity
controls.description: How hollowed-out the nebula is — 0 fills the volume with cloud banks, high carves large dark voids between them

controls.name: dust
controls.description: Cold dark dust lanes threading the gas — absorb-only tendrils that redden the clouds and stars behind them

controls.name: gasScale
controls.description: Feature size of the gas — higher = finer, busier cloud detail

controls.name: billow
controls.description: Turbulent folding of the clouds — 0 = smooth drifting banks, 1 = heavily churned billows

controls.name: glow
controls.description: Hot emission bloom of the dense cores

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed — pans the gas field to a different region of noise space for a new cloud composition

controls.name: stars
controls.description: Brightness of the star fields drifting at depth behind and inside the gas

controls.name: starScale
controls.description: Density of the star fields — higher = smaller, busier stars

controls.name: twinkle
controls.description: Intensity of the star twinkle (0 = steady stars, 1 = full shimmer)

controls.name: refraction
controls.description: How strongly the curved glass walls bend the interior seen near the edges

controls.name: environment
controls.description: Strength of the studio softboxes reflected in the polished glass surface

controls.name: highlight
controls.description: Sharp key-light glint on the glass

controls.name: highlightSoftness

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed of the slowly churning gas and twinkling stars. 0 freezes the nebula.

summary.zh: 轮廓化作带光泽的霓虹管，适合招牌与图标。
summary.ja: 輪郭を光沢のあるネオン管に変える。看板やアイコンに。
summary.en: Photorealistic neon tube / 3D pipe effect driven by a custom shape

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the neon shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the neon shape in degrees

controls.name: color
controls.description: Primary neon tube color

controls.name: secondaryColor
controls.description: Shadow-side color for a two-tone / dual-lit pipe look

controls.name: secondaryBlend
controls.description: Blend between mono (0) and two-tone (1) tube coloring

controls.name: glowColor

controls.description: How far inward from the boundary the tube extends. Low = thin neon outline, high = thick 3D pipe

controls.name: intensity

controls.name: hotCoreIntensity
controls.description: Bright white-hot center line — the gas discharge glow inside the tube

controls.name: glowIntensity

controls.description: How far the glow extends beyond the tube

controls.name: lightAngle

controls.name: specularIntensity

controls.name: specularSize
controls.description: Specular highlight size — 0 = tight pinpoint, 1 = broad sheen

controls.name: cornerSmoothing
controls.description: Rounds sharp corners to mimic how real glass tubes curve at bends

controls.name: flickerSpeed
controls.description: Flicker animation speed — 0 = off, higher = faster sporadic on/off

controls.description: How often the neon flickers off — 0 = always on, 1 = frequent outages

controls.name: flowSpeed
controls.description: Flow animation speed — 0 = off, light rotates through the tube

controls.name: flowAmount
controls.description: Strength of the flowing brightness variation — 0 = uniform, 1 = dramatic

summary.zh: 近黑表面在斜边泛出虹彩，适合暗色质感标志。
summary.ja: 黒い面の斜めの縁に虹色が浮かぶ。暗色のロゴに。
summary.en: Dark tinted glass whose faces stay near-black while every surface turning away from the viewer ignites with a flowing iridescent gradient — vivid color living only on the oblique walls and bevels

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the glass shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the glass shape in degrees

controls.name: bodyColor
controls.description: The dark body of the glass — what the faces looking straight at you show. Keep it deep for the iridescence to pop.

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: First iridescent color (two-color fallback when stops are cleared)

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Second iridescent color (two-color fallback when stops are cleared)

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

controls.name: iridescence
controls.description: Strength of the color on the oblique surfaces — 0 = plain dark glass, above 1 = saturated neon walls

controls.name: rimWidth
controls.description: How far in from edge-on the color reaches — small keeps it to the steepest walls, large lets it creep across gently turning faces

controls.name: rimSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the transition from dark face to colored wall

controls.name: flowAngle
controls.description: Direction the gradient flows across the surface, in degrees

controls.name: flowScale
controls.description: How many times the palette cycles across the shape — higher = tighter color bands

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed the gradient flows along the walls. 0 pauses.

controls.name: gloss
controls.description: Strength of the studio softboxes reflected in the glass — the pale highlights riding the top edges

controls.name: envRotation
controls.description: Rotates the reflected studio — spins where the bright reflections fall

controls.name: bevelWidth
controls.description: Width of the edge bevel on flat shapes — the band that turns away from the viewer and catches the color

controls.name: bevelShape
controls.description: Bevel profile — 0 = one smooth round fillet, 1 = machined: a steep outer fillet, a chamfer plateau and an inner knee

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

summary.zh: 画面从角落卷起剥离，适合翻页切换。
summary.ja: 隅から画面を巻いてはがす。ページの切り替えに。

controls.description: Which corner the page peels from

controls.name: amount
controls.description: How far the peel has progressed across the page (0 = flat, 1 = fully peeled)

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Tightness of the curl (fraction of the page diagonal)

controls.name: shading
controls.description: How much the underside of the curl is shaded for depth

controls.name: highlight
controls.description: Strength of the specular sheen running along the curl

controls.name: highlightSoftness

label.ja: ハイライトの柔らかさ

controls.description: Width of the specular highlight band (low = tight gloss, high = broad satin)

controls.name: shadow
controls.description: Strength of the contact shadow the curl casts on the page

summary.zh: 纸张纤维与粗糙感覆盖底图，适合纸本风配图。
summary.ja: 紙の繊維やざらつきを重ねる。紙面風の挿絵に。
summary.en: Applies realistic paper grain and surface roughness to child content

controls.name: roughness
controls.description: Surface roughness — higher values create more pronounced brightness variation

controls.name: grainScale
controls.description: Scale of the paper grain — lower = coarser, higher = finer

controls.name: displacement
controls.description: Surface micro-roughness — shifts pixels at grain scale like real paper fiber bumps

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed for pattern variation

summary.zh: 宽高与倾斜可调的斜方块，适合几何装饰。

controls.description: Fill color of the parallelogram

controls.name: strokeColor

controls.name: strokePosition
controls.description: Position of the stroke relative to the shape edge

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for blending fill and stroke colors

summary.zh: 底图炸开成立体粒子并响应指针，适合互动海报。
summary.ja: 画像を立体的な粒子に分ける。操作できるポスターに。
summary.en: Explodes the child content into a breathing 3D field of particles — bright areas float toward you and dark areas recede, the whole relief can be orbited with the camera rotations, and the cursor physically throws particles that spring back home

controls.name: count
controls.description: Number of particles — how finely the child is sampled into the field

controls.name: depthSource
controls.description: Which channel of the child drives each particle's depth toward or away from the camera

controls.name: depth
controls.description: Depth of the relief — how far bright and dark areas rise toward and sink away from the camera

controls.name: particleShape
controls.description: What each particle is drawn as — a crisp dot or square, or a soft glow puff

controls.name: particleSize
controls.description: Size of each particle relative to the grid spacing

controls.name: depthShading
controls.description: How much far particles dim into the distance — the main cue that sells the 3D relief

controls.name: wobble
controls.description: Gentle idle drift that keeps the field breathing even on a still image

controls.name: zoom
controls.description: Camera distance — dolly the whole field closer or further away

controls.name: rotationX
controls.description: Camera orbit around the horizontal axis — tilt the relief toward or away from you

controls.name: rotationY
controls.description: Camera orbit around the vertical axis — view the particle extrusion from the side

controls.name: rotationZ
controls.description: Camera roll around the view axis

controls.name: offsetX
controls.description: Shift the whole field horizontally across the frame (in screen widths)

controls.name: offsetY
controls.description: Shift the whole field vertically across the frame (in screen heights) — tilt it flat, then sink it toward the bottom like a ground plane

controls.name: cursorMode
controls.description: How the cursor disturbs the field — push throws particles away and toward you, pull gathers them in

controls.name: cursorStrength
controls.description: Strength of the cursor force — how hard particles get thrown before springing back

controls.name: cursorRadius
controls.description: Reach of the cursor field, in screen units

summary.zh: 微尘随流体与指针翻卷，适合互动氛围背景。
summary.ja: 塵が流体やカーソルで渦を巻く。操作する背景に。
summary.en: Thousands of drifting dust particles carried by a real incompressible fluid field the cursor stirs — drag to plow a wake and the particles ride the eddies and vortices it leaves behind, while a gentle ambient breeze keeps the whole scene breathing on its own

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Color of particles drifting slowly with the flow

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Color particles flash toward as they speed up in the fast jets and wakes

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for the rest→excited color ramp

controls.name: shape
controls.description: What each particle is drawn as — a streak or arrow that stretches along the flow, a plain dot, a square, or a soft glowing comet

controls.name: count
controls.description: Number of drifting particles

controls.name: size
controls.description: Size of each particle

controls.name: trails
controls.description: How long each particle's motion trail persists — 0 draws crisp dust, 1 leaves long flowing ribbons

controls.name: speed
controls.description: How strongly the fluid carries the particles — higher makes the dust ride the flow faster

controls.name: force
controls.description: How hard the cursor's motion pushes the fluid — higher plows faster, more violent wakes and jets

controls.name: swirl
controls.description: Vorticity confinement — swirl energy that spins the flow into persistent eddies and vortices the dust orbits

controls.name: momentum
controls.description: How long the fluid keeps flowing after you stop dragging — high momentum lets the eddies carry the dust on and on

controls.name: ambient
controls.description: A gentle, ever-evolving breeze that keeps the dust drifting even without the cursor — set to 0 for a field that only moves when you stir it

summary.zh: 粒子聚成形状并随指针散开，适合互动标志。
summary.ja: 粒子が形を作りカーソルで散る。触れるロゴに。
summary.en: A swarm of simulated particles that settles into the shape, filling it evenly — flat, SVG or true 3D volumes — scattering from the cursor (or chasing it), tumbling when the shape moves, and always drifting back home

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the shape in degrees

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Color of particles at rest

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Color particles shift toward when agitated — scattering from the cursor or catching up to a moving shape

controls.name: count
controls.description: Number of simulated particles

controls.name: size
controls.description: Base particle size (each particle also varies slightly, and grows as it drifts toward the viewer)

controls.name: particleShape
controls.description: What each particle is drawn as — a crisp dot or square (softness still feathers them), or a soft glow puff

controls.name: spread
controls.description: The pressure pushing particles apart — how strongly they insist on even spacing inside the shape

controls.name: agitation
controls.description: Idle thermal motion of the swarm — 0 freezes it crystal-still once settled

controls.name: damping
controls.description: How quickly disturbed particles calm back down and settle into place

controls.name: gravity
controls.description: Downward pull on the swarm — negative floats the particles upward

controls.name: mouseInfluence
controls.description: Strength of the cursor field. Positive scatters particles away; negative pulls the swarm toward the cursor

controls.name: mouseRadius
controls.description: Reach of the cursor field, in shape-local units

controls.name: exposure
controls.description: Brightness of the additive particle glow

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Edge softness of each particle — 0 is a crisp disc, 1 a soft glow puff

controls.name: depth
controls.description: Thickness of the particle volume behind flat shapes (3D shapes use their own true depth)

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for the rest→excited color ramp

summary.zh: 平滑噪声慢慢变幻，适合云纹和自然底图。

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed for pattern variation

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Animation speed

controls.name: pan
controls.description: Horizontal rotation (left/right)

controls.name: tilt
controls.description: Vertical rotation (up/down)

controls.name: fov
controls.description: Field of view - controls perspective intensity

controls.name: zoom
controls.description: Zoom in to fill the frame after rotation

controls.name: edges

summary.zh: 指针周围像素按亮度拉开，适合互动故障画面。

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Size of the cursor brush that sorts pixels

controls.name: falloff
controls.description: Softness of the brush edge (0 = hard circle, 1 = very soft)

controls.name: strength
controls.description: How fast pixels sort — runs more sorting passes per frame

controls.name: decay
controls.description: How quickly sorted pixels melt back to their original position (0 = permanent)

controls.name: direction

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed for pattern variation

summary.zh: 距离场铺成细胞纹理，适合石块和有机底纹。
summary.ja: 距離場から細胞状の模様を作る。石や有機的な下地に。
summary.en: Cellular noise field — distance-based, with selectable feature combinations and fractal octaves

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Color where the noise field is low (typically near cell centers)

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Color where the noise field is high (typically near cell boundaries)

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Number of cells across the canvas at the base octave

controls.name: mode
controls.description: Field type. F1 = distance to nearest point. F2 = distance to second-nearest. F2 − F1 emphasises cell boundaries.

controls.name: distance
controls.description: Distance metric. Euclidean = round cells. Manhattan = diamond. Chebyshev = square.

controls.name: octaves
controls.description: Number of fractal layers stacked at progressively finer scales

controls.name: lacunarity
controls.description: Scale multiplier between octaves (only active when Octaves > 1)

controls.name: persistence
controls.description: Amplitude multiplier between octaves (only active when Octaves > 1)

controls.name: jitter
controls.description: How much each cell's point drifts inside its cell. 0 = rigid grid (banded look), 1 = fully random.

controls.name: contrast
controls.description: Steepness of the gradient between low and high regions

controls.name: balance
controls.description: Shifts the gradient midpoint. Negative pulls the field toward Color A, positive toward Color B.

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed — shifts the cell pattern without changing its overall structure

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Animation speed — how fast each cell's point drifts

summary.zh: 残影从中心向外放射，适合冲刺和镜头推近。
summary.ja: 中心から外へ残像を伸ばす。加速やズームの表現に。
summary.en: Radial zoom blur expanding from a center point

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Intensity of the zoom blur effect

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: Spectral color fringing along the streak, like light through a lens; negative flips which end is red

controls.name: falloff
controls.description: Concentrates the dispersion away from the center; 0 fringes everywhere equally

controls.name: focus
controls.description: Radius of a clean zone around the center that stays sharp

controls.name: bias
controls.description: Slides the streak window: 0 streaks inward from each pixel, 1 streaks evenly both ways, -1 pushes it further in

controls.name: highlights
controls.description: Lets bright pixels streak further than dark ones, like light rays

controls.name: spiral
controls.description: Twists the radial streak into a vortex around the center

controls.name: jitter
controls.description: Per-pixel noise on the tap spacing that hides banding in long streaks

summary.zh: 轮廓边缘泛起薄膜彩光，适合虹彩材质展示。
summary.ja: 輪郭に薄膜の虹色が浮かぶ。玉虫色の質感表現に。
summary.en: Iridescent thin-film edge

controls.name: scale
controls.description: Scale of the shape (1 = default size)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the shape in degrees

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Rim brightness — values above 1 push the edge past white for HDR bloom

controls.name: rimWidth
controls.description: How far inward from the edge the iridescence reaches

controls.name: edgeSoftness
controls.description: Softness of the shape boundary

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Film thickness — higher values pack more spectral bands across the rim

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: How strongly color separates around the perimeter (warm vs cool sides)

controls.name: saturation
controls.description: Spectral saturation — 0 = white rim, 1 = full iridescence

controls.name: hueShift
controls.description: Rotate the spectrum to reposition the colors

controls.name: lightAngle
controls.description: Light angle in degrees — sets which side of the rim runs warm vs cool

controls.name: mode
controls.description: Rainbow uses the full iridescent spectrum; Custom cycles through your three chosen colors

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: First color in the rim cycle

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Second color in the rim cycle

controls.name: colorC
controls.description: Third color in the rim cycle

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: color space used to blend between custom colors

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Speed at which the colors rotate around the rim (0 = static)

summary.zh: 焦点外逐渐模糊，适合微缩景观风配图。
summary.ja: 焦点の外を徐々にぼかす。ミニチュア風の挿絵に。
summary.en: Selective focus blur mimicking tilt-shift photography

controls.name: intensity
controls.description: Maximum blur intensity at edges

controls.name: width
controls.description: Width of the sharp focus area

controls.name: falloff
controls.description: Distance over which blur transitions to full strength

controls.name: angle
controls.description: Rotation angle of the focus line (in degrees)

controls.name: dispersion
controls.description: Blurs red and blue by different amounts for a lens-like color fringe outside the focus band; negative swaps the colors

controls.name: jitter
controls.description: Per-pixel noise on the tap spacing that hides banding at large blur radii

summary.zh: 移动画面留下渐淡残影，适合长曝光和光绘。
summary.ja: 動く画像が薄れる残像を残す。長時間露光や光跡に。
summary.en: An Echo-style temporal trail — whatever moves sheds a smooth, decaying long-exposure ghost trail (frame-difference Motion mode works on opaque images and video; Alpha mode trails a shape's coverage), with optional zoom-feedback tunnels and rainbow light-painting

controls.name: trailSource
controls.description: What sheds the trail — Motion trails whatever changes frame-to-frame (works on opaque images and video), Alpha trails the child's transparency coverage (best for a clean shape over empty canvas)

controls.name: motionThreshold
controls.description: How much a pixel must change between frames to shed a trail (Motion source only) — lower catches subtle movement, higher only fast motion

controls.name: trailLength
controls.description: How long the trail lingers, in seconds — the time constant of the fade (the star control)

controls.name: diffusion
controls.description: How much the trail smears and softens as it fades — 0 keeps crisp ghost frames, higher melts them together

controls.name: trailOpacity
controls.description: Overall strength of the trail behind the live frame

controls.name: trailBlend
controls.description: How the trail combines with the frame — Add / Screen build glowing light-painting trails, Multiply lays down dark ink ghosts, plus the full standard blend set

controls.name: driftX
controls.description: Sideways drift of the trail per second — smears the trail in a direction

controls.name: driftY
controls.description: Vertical drift of the trail per second

controls.name: zoom
controls.description: Per-frame zoom of the trail around the centre — above 1 pulls the trail into an outward tunnel, below 1 sucks it inward

controls.name: tintMode
controls.description: color the trail — Color tints it a single hue, Rainbow cycles hue as the trail ages

controls.name: tint
controls.description: Trail tint color (used in Color mode)

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Simulation speed. 0 freezes the trail in place.

summary.zh: 给底图蒙上一层色调，适合统一图片气氛。
summary.ja: 画像に色を重ねる。全体の雰囲気をそろえる際に。
summary.en: Apply a color tint to the image

controls.name: color
controls.description: Tint color

controls.name: amount
controls.description: Tint amount (0 = no tint, 1 = full tint)

controls.name: preserveLuminosity
controls.description: Preserve original brightness

summary.zh: 上下边宽与高度可调，适合几何图形与遮罩。
summary.ja: 上下の幅と高さを調整できる台形。図形やマスクに。
summary.en: Trapezoid with adjustable top and bottom widths and height

controls.name: color
controls.description: Fill color of the trapezoid

controls.name: bottomWidth
controls.description: Half-width of the bottom edge

controls.name: topWidth
controls.description: Half-width of the top edge

controls.name: height
controls.description: Half-height of the trapezoid

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation in degrees

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Edge softness for antialiasing

controls.name: strokeThickness
controls.description: Stroke thickness. Zero means no stroke.

controls.name: strokeColor
controls.description: Color of the stroke outline

controls.name: strokePosition
controls.description: Position of the stroke relative to the shape edge

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for blending fill and stroke colors

summary.zh: 等边三角形错行铺开，适合几何底纹。
summary.ja: 正三角形を行ごとにずらして並べる。幾何学的な下地に。
summary.en: Tiling grid of equilateral triangles with optional animated row offsets

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Triangle fill color

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Grid line color

controls.name: cells
controls.description: Number of triangle rows down the shortest canvas edge

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Thickness of the grid lines (0 = no lines)

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the grid in degrees

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Softness of the line edges (0 = crisp, 1 = very soft)

controls.name: variation
controls.description: Per-triangle random lightening/darkening of the fill color

controls.name: speed
controls.description: Animates the triangle rows drifting horizontally (0 = static)

controls.name: speedVariance
controls.description: Per-row random speed variance for irregular drifting motion

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

summary.zh: 阴影、中间调与高光各染一色，适合海报调色。
summary.ja: 暗部・中間調・明部を三色にする。ポスターの配色に。
summary.en: Map colors to three tones: shadows, midtones, highlights

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: First color (used for shadows/darkest areas)

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Second color (used for midtones)

controls.name: colorC
controls.description: Third color (used for highlights/brightest areas)

controls.name: blendMid
controls.description: Midpoint position between the three colors

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation

summary.zh: 四分之一圆弧拼成流动迷宫，适合曲线底纹。
summary.ja: 四分円をつないで迷路のような線を作る。曲線の背景模様に。
summary.en: Quarter-circle arc tiles that connect to form organic, maze-like flowing curves

controls.name: colorA
controls.description: Background color between the arcs

controls.name: colorB
controls.description: Arc line color

controls.name: cells
controls.description: Number of tiles across the shortest canvas edge

controls.name: thickness
controls.description: Thickness of the arc lines

controls.name: rotation
controls.description: Rotation of the tiling in degrees

controls.name: softness
controls.description: Softness of the arc edges (0 = crisp, 1 = very soft)

controls.name: seed
controls.description: Random seed — changes which tiles flip, producing a different maze pattern

controls.name: colorSpace
controls.description: Color space for color interpolation
